rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name + zip, reviewed the delivered order, asked for confirmation before making changes, and attempted the exchange using the stored payment method. However, it fabricated critical details: it listed Medium/blue/high as available and priced at $219.88 without tool support; the product details shown did not include that variant or that price, and the only Medium variant visible (red/high) was cheaper than the original. The agent then submitted an exchange using a new_item_id (9013366374) that was never retrieved from the product tool. Providing an unsupported price/availability and inventing an item ID violates the policy against inventing facts and not inspecting products fully before committing changes. Therefore, despite confirmation, the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
